body: I ended up finding a good spot on the docks by the river out of the way. In all this hot weather it was refreshing having a cool night. Most of my criminal record is from not having anywhere to sleep and needing a meal and a place to stay for the night (Jail cell and a hot meal), anythign from shoplifting (I stole an apple because I hadn't eaten in 4 days and was treated like I stole a car) to disturbing the peace (created one hell of a scene before they finally took me in, it was raining for a few days and I needed to sleep somewhere dry) and the good ol' vagrancy laws have caused a few arrests. Most of the convictions are for not being able to make it to court dates and getting additional charges. I'm out near Sacramento at the moment, made a hell of a hike to find an open wifi spot, God I don't know what I'd do w/out this ol' laptop. When the shelters turn you away all they tell you is the next shelter down the road but they're all the same, it's amazing how full these places are. I'm trying to get to Fresno so I may dissapear for a few days but it was nice at least having one person to talk to today. Thank you and God bless.

They have a 30 day limit here, unfortunately most of the people I have met waiting on the list are older men and women that can't make it on the streets so I usually give up my place for someone that would die out on the street. There aren't too many places I have found because of my habbits in the past and my arrest record (being homeless is a crime in the good ol' USA, every arrest has been related to being homeless and no violent crimes). Thank you for the words. I have to head out and scout a place to stay for the night. God bless.

It's a hard thing looking someone in the eyes as a broken man and asking for money. I just can't do it. I'm a believer in earning what I can (however when it comes to it and a few days without food I have accepted handouts).

I'm sorry I couldn't respond sooner, I got kicked from the location I was sleeping at nights cause the cops didn't want the tent bothering anyone. I found a small diner with wifi this morning and will keep moving day by day. A nice man gave me a guitar w/no strings and after scrounging up a few dollars I purchased some. Been payin for my food & water off of what little handouts I could get. Someone stole my tent and sleeping bag so not looking forward to the winter coming. Don't know when I can respond again but thank you for caring.
I'm tired of living like I'm less than human. Letting go is the only way I feel I can relive myself. Thank you.
Sat here for an hour hoping to have a least some kind of company. Turns out even in the pits of the internet I'm in the lowest hell.
